selected_gaps.gap: 在固定 quantizer、controller 与 deployment budget 下，是否存在跨控制时刻可重复的 residual persistence、sign correlation 或 cancellation，使后续 state/action drift 比 instantaneous residual energy 更可预测，现有 leaves 尚未把这些 temporal modes 与 held-out outcome 分离出来 — stakes: 机器人部署者可能为不导致长期漂移的瞬时误差浪费高精度，而研究者会把 aggregate trajectory correlation 误读成可迁移的量化机制。
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: 异质分解本身产出 temporal residual modes 与 signed accumulation object，但 method 型贡献还需要一个可运行的 confound-isolating diagnostic 来区分真实 coherent accumulation 与 energy-matched phase shuffle；controlled_diagnostic_design 正好提供该 paired intervention 与 downstream separation。
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: 这是最直接决定 bottleneck 是否可辨识、且能产出固定预算 PTQ method 的 gap；其余 state-distribution gap 可作为 transfer 检验但不是 anchor 的必要模块。heterogeneous_decomposition 将 residual sequence 按 persistence/cancellation 结构分解为可计算对象，controlled_diagnostic_design 再用 same-state paired replay 与 phase-shuffle isolate 该对象对 downstream drift 的作用。

deliverable_coverage: method — anchor gap → heterogeneous_decomposition yields the temporal-mode calibration object, and companion controlled_diagnostic_design ships the runnable matched intervention and downstream separation

user_direction_disposition.user_wanted: 用时间序列 residual 的累积/衰减结构与闭环状态漂移来校准或分配 precision
user_direction_disposition.chosen: 以 paired FP/Q closed-loop rollouts 的 signed temporal residual accumulation 进行 conditional joint-map calibration，并用 phase-shuffle downstream diagnostic 验证其作用

deferred_gaps.gap: 当量化策略的动作改变其后续 visited-state distribution 时，校准统计是否仍在同一个误差机制上有效，还是只在初始 calibration states 上成立，现有 leaves 尚未在固定预算下用独立 fit、state-shift 与 downstream transfer 共同判定这一点 — stakes: 低比特策略可能在离线指标正常时于接触或长时段控制中失效，且不同 benchmark 的结论无法解释性迁移。
deferred_gaps.reason: fails removal test — the anchor's temporal-mode diagnostic can be run and falsified without making a separate state-distribution adaptation module; state-shift transfer remains a validation axis

deferred_gaps.gap: 现有 quantization leaves 共同继承了把 residual 主要视为可加的局部或单步幅度、再由静态分数决定保护的组件；是否必须接受这种 residual independence / memory assumption，而不能把它当作闭环 PTQ 的无条件前提，仍未被检验 — stakes: 一个未检验的共享假设会使多篇 calibration 结果在 state feedback 下失去外推基础，并阻塞可审计的精度设计。
deferred_gaps.reason: fails removal test — this foundation question is tested by the anchor's explicit coherent-versus-shuffled residual diagnostic and does not need a second paper leg
